frameworks.name: Executive decision storyline
frameworks.description: Situation, complication, insight, recommendation, impact, risk, and next-step spine for decision-oriented decks.

sections.title: Complication
sections.purpose: The change or tension that forces a decision.

sections.title: Insight
sections.purpose: The non-obvious finding that reframes the problem.

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.purpose: The specific ask, stated before the detail.

sections.title: Impact
sections.purpose: Quantified value, cost, and risk of the recommendation.

sections.title: Risks and mitigations
sections.purpose: What could go wrong and how it is contained.

sections.title: Next steps
sections.purpose: Owners, dates, and the decision required today.

frameworks.closing_note: Keep the recommendation on screen while you walk the evidence.

frameworks.name: Beginning, development, resolution, action
frameworks.description: General purpose narrative arc that works for keynotes, all-hands, and mixed audiences.

sections.title: Opening
sections.purpose: State the promise of the session.

sections.title: What we will do
sections.purpose: Show the response as a sequence.

sections.title: Close
sections.purpose: Return to the promise and the action.

frameworks.closing_note: End on the action, not on a thank-you slide.

frameworks.name: Teaching sequence
frameworks.description: Objectives, prior knowledge, explanation, worked example, guided practice, check for understanding, summary, and extension.

sections.title: Objectives
sections.purpose: What learners will be able to do.

sections.title: Explanation
sections.purpose: The core idea, one idea per slide.

sections.title: Check for understanding
sections.purpose: A question or quick task with a known answer.

sections.title: Summary
sections.purpose: Restate the method in three steps.

sections.title: Extension
sections.purpose: Where to go next and where to get help.

frameworks.closing_note: Leave the summary slide visible during questions.

frameworks.name: Sales story
frameworks.description: Customer problem, stakes, solution, proof, differentiation, value, objections, offer, and next action.

sections.title: Their problem
sections.purpose: Describe the customer's world in their words.

sections.title: Why us
sections.purpose: Differentiation on the criteria they care about.

sections.title: Objections
sections.purpose: Name the top three objections and the response.

frameworks.closing_note: Never leave the offer slide for the very end without a dated next step.

frameworks.name: Technical architecture briefing
frameworks.description: Context, requirements, architecture, data flow, interfaces, trade-offs, implementation, testing, risks, and roadmap.

sections.title: Context
sections.purpose: System boundaries and the problem being solved.

sections.title: Data flow
sections.purpose: How data moves and where it is stored.

sections.title: Trade-offs
sections.purpose: Options, why this one, what was rejected.

frameworks.closing_note: Keep the architecture diagram on screen for the entire discussion.

frameworks.name: Investor pitch
frameworks.description: Problem, solution, market, product, traction, business model, competition, go-to-market, team, financials, ask.
frameworks.closing_note: Put the ask and current round status on one slide and leave it up.

frameworks.name: Project status review
frameworks.description: Objectives, accomplishments, milestones, schedule, budget, risks, decisions, dependencies, and next steps.

sections.title: Accomplishments
sections.purpose: What shipped since the last review.

sections.title: Decisions needed
sections.purpose: Each with options and a recommendation.

sections.title: Next steps
sections.purpose: Owners and dates for the next period.

frameworks.call_to_action: Decide {decision} today so {dependency} stays on track for {date}.
frameworks.closing_note: Lead with the decision, not the activity list, when time is short.

frameworks.name: Research findings
frameworks.description: Question, background, method, results, uncertainty, limitations, interpretation, and references.

sections.title: Question
sections.purpose: The question and why it matters.

sections.title: Interpretation
sections.purpose: What the results mean, and what they do not.

frameworks.call_to_action: Adopt {practice} or fund {next_study} based on these findings.
frameworks.closing_note: Show uncertainty on the results slide rather than hiding it in the appendix.

frameworks.name: Marketing campaign plan
frameworks.description: Audience, insight, message, channel, creative direction, content plan, budget, schedule, measurement, and optimisation.

sections.title: Message
sections.purpose: The single line we want repeated.

sections.title: Channels
sections.purpose: Where, how often, and at what cost.

sections.title: Optimisation
sections.purpose: What we change if results miss.

frameworks.closing_note: Pair every channel with its measurement before approval.

frameworks.name: Training and onboarding
frameworks.description: Role context, process, demonstration, scenario, practice, assessment, support, and follow-up.

sections.title: Role context
sections.purpose: Where this task sits in the job.

sections.title: Scenario
sections.purpose: A realistic case with a trap in it.

sections.title: Practice
sections.purpose: Hands-on task in the real tool.

sections.title: Support
sections.purpose: Where to get help and how fast.

frameworks.call_to_action: Complete {assessment} by {date} and log questions in {channel}.
frameworks.closing_note: Leave the support slide up while learners practise.

frameworks.name: Event and conference deck
frameworks.description: Branded opening, agenda, speaker slides, sponsors, session content, logistics, calls to action, and closing.

sections.title: Speakers
sections.purpose: Who is on stage and why.

sections.title: Closing
sections.purpose: Thank-yous and where to find material.

frameworks.call_to_action: Register for {next_event} and share feedback by {date}.
frameworks.closing_note: Keep logistics available as a hidden slide for interruptions.

frameworks.name: Portfolio case study
frameworks.description: Challenge, role, process, iterations, solution, evidence, outcomes, and lessons.

sections.title: Lessons
sections.purpose: What you would repeat or change.

frameworks.closing_note: Attribute outcomes accurately; say what you did not control.

frameworks.name: Asynchronous card document
frameworks.description: Self-contained sections that read without a presenter, for Gamma-style responsive pages or web publishing.

sections.title: Summary
sections.purpose: The whole message in five lines.

sections.title: Context
sections.purpose: What the reader needs to know first.

frameworks.closing_note: Every card must stand alone: no build sequences, no speaker-only context.

frameworks.name: Nonlinear spatial story
frameworks.description: Topic, subtopic, and return paths for Prezi-style spatial navigation or audience-driven branching.

sections.title: Overview
sections.purpose: The whole map before any detail.

sections.title: Topic 1
sections.purpose: A first-level topic with a visible return path.

sections.title: Topic 2
sections.purpose: A first-level topic with a visible return path.

sections.title: Topic 3
sections.purpose: A first-level topic with a visible return path.

sections.title: Return and close
sections.purpose: Back to the overview before the ask.

frameworks.call_to_action: Choose the path to explore and record the decision in {channel}.
frameworks.closing_note: Cap zoom travel so the audience never loses orientation.
